final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(college_id, '') AS college_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college GROUP BY COALESCE(college_id, '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts), above AS (SELECT record_count FROM college_counts WHERE record_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM overall)) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(1.0 * record_count / (SELECT total_count FROM overall)) AS average_share_of_all_records, AVG(record_count - (SELECT avg_count FROM overall)) AS average_excess_overall_average FROM above
